option_relations.rationale: High-degree atrioventricular block is a broader category that includes complete heart block.

Infrahisian Mobitz type I second-degree AV block (Wenckebach phenomenon occurring in His-Purkinje system) is a type of AV block that can progress to or be considered a form of high-degree block, which can lead to complete heart block.
Bradyarrhythmia due to conduction system disease is a broad category that includes complete heart block as a specific type of bradyarrhythmia caused by conduction system dysfunction.
Progressive cardiac conduction disease is a broader condition that can manifest as or lead to complete heart block.
